Callout.Name: Assault Victim
Callout.Message: Person assaulted, bleeding from a head wound.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect gone, victim on the pavement, conscious.

Script.Line: Two of them. It came out of nowhere.
I did not get a proper look. Baseball cap, dark jacket, that is all.
Which way did they go? Tell me which way they went.

Callout.Patient: I did not even see them. Is it bad?

Lines.Approach: Suspect has gone. The victim is on the pavement and the head wound is a bad one.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
